title: Newton's Laws in Action: Why Do Cars Need Seatbelts?

content.summary: Explore how Newton's laws of motion explain the physics behind car safety and the importance of seatbelts in protecting passengers during collisions.
key_questions: What happens to passengers when a car suddenly stops?
How do seatbelts use physics to save lives?
content.historical_context: Isaac Newton formulated his three laws of motion in the Principia Mathematica in 1687, fundamentally changing our understanding of forces and motion.
content.mathematical_framework: Newton's first law states that objects in motion tend to stay in motion unless acted upon by an external force. F=ma describes the relationship between force, mass, and acceleration.
